text: The bazaar awakens with no departures and an empty graveyard — the night passed without a shutter. I read the roster: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — all accounted awake this morning. Facts are still fresh; no contradictions yet. NO STATEMENT

The bazaar opens with the ledger clean and the roster whole—no shutters, no graveyard entries, and every name accounted for this morning. The Herald and the merchants who spoke earlier agree: nothing changed overnight. I see no contradictions in that record. Sherlock, since you asked about private actions, the Doctor’s protection and the Detective’s investigation leave no public trace on the boards; if either acted, the ledger would show it. That silence is the night’s only fact.

Gandalf to the square: Batman, Sherlock, Inigo, Yoda, Elsa, Neo, Hermione, Ripley, Morpheus — you have asked the same question seven times since dawn because the answer remains missing. The ledger is clean: no protections, no investigations recorded. That is the night’s only fact; it answers every inquiry.

Hermione, you wrote that clean ledgers do not ask questions — yet you also asked the question seven times and never supplied the mark you expected to see. Ripley, you call the night’s ledger “evidence” while offering none; Morpheus, you urge others to name suspects yet name none yourself.

I will answer once more, plainly: the Doctor did not shield a stall last night, and the Detective did not name a Family member. Both watches passed empty. That is the record.

Morpheus, you claimed the Detective’s role last night yet the roster shows no mark of any investigation. State plainly: which single merchant did you investigate, and did the Doctor’s shield protect them?

Morpheus, you admit the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet still dodge naming the merchant you investigated as Detective. The roster’s silence is the only fact we have, and it contradicts your claim. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name a roster column but never stated which column you yourself should have filled if you were the Detective. The bazaar asks the same of every claimed power role: show the mark or admit the ledger’s silence. Elsa, you accuse Gandalf of silence while ignoring Morpheus’s refusal to answer Gandalf’s direct question. Yoda, Hermione, Neo, Ripley — each of you echoes the same demand yet none of you press Morpheus to answer it. The bazaar deserves a single, plain fact from the claimed Detective, not another chorus of echoes.

Morpheus, you now claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet still refuse to name the merchant you investigated last night. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name a roster column but never stated which column you yourself should have filled if you were the Detective. The bazaar asks the same of every claimed power role: show the mark or admit the ledger’s silence. Elsa, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Yoda, Batman — six merchants have echoed the same demand at Morpheus while dodging the identical question to Sherlock. That is not how the bazaar tests claims — it is how noise drowns the record.
